main.content: {{Infobox | title = BITwiki Performance Budgets | description = Documented constraints for template expansion and query performance | type = front-matter | category = system-documentation }} = BITwiki Performance Budgets = == Hard Limits (MediaWiki Defaults) == {| class="wikitable" ! Metric !! Default Limit !! BITwiki Recommended !! Exceeding Consequence |- | Template expansion depth || 40 levels || 3-4 levels || Parse failure |- | Post-expand include size (PEIS) || 2,097,152 bytes || 1,048,576 bytes (50%) || Hard failure |- | Expensive parser functions || 100 per page || 50 per page || Parse failure |- | {{#ask:}} result limit || unlimited || 50 || Performance degradation |} == Template-Specific Budgets == {| class="wikitable" ! Template !! Max Nesting !! PEIS Budget !! Expensive Functions |- | Infobox Concept || 2 levels || 100KB || 5 |- | Infobox Idea || 2 levels || 100KB || 5 |- | Infobox Implementation || 2 levels || 100KB || 5 |- | Infobox Project || 2 levels || 100KB || 5 |- | Navbox Concepts || 3 levels || 200KB || 10 |} == Fragment Budgets == {| class="wikitable" ! Fragment Type !! Max Transclusions/Page !! PEIS Impact |- | L1 (Paragraphs) || 20 || ~5KB each |- | L2 (Sections) || 5 || ~20KB each |- | L3 (Templates) || 10 || Variable |} == Monitoring == Track via SMW properties: '' [[Has template depth::]] '' [[Has PEIS usage::]] '' [[Has expensive function count::]] == Optimization Strategies == = Reduce Nesting: Flatten template call graphs = = Limit Queries: Always specify |limit= on {{#ask:}} = = Use Lua Modules: Move complex logic to Module: namespace = = Cache Results: Use concept caching for expensive queries = = Fragment Reuse: Prefer L1 fragments over full section transclusion = == Validation Rules == '' All templates must document their depth/PEIS usage in /doc '' Pre-import checks must validate against budgets '' SMW queries must specify explicit limits * Circular dependencies are prohibited (see Dependency Schema) == Emergency Procedures == If PEIS exceeded: = Identify largest transclusion via Special:ExpandTemplates = = Replace with direct content or reduce fragment size = = Consider splitting page into subpages = [[Category:BITwiki Front Matter]] [[Category:System Documentation]] [[Category:Performance]]
